items.explanation: After two, three, four… the noun takes plural -s: three days, not `three day`.
items.explanation_cz: Po two, three, four… má podstatné jméno množné -s: three days, ne `three day`.

items.explanation: Number above one → plural noun.
items.explanation_cz: Číslo větší než jedna → množné číslo.

items.en: I read the book in one day.
items.cz: Přečetla jsem tu knihu za jeden den.
items.gap: I read the book in one ____.
accepts: I read the book in one day.
items.explanation: one keeps the singular — and no `a` with it: in one day, not `in a one day`.
items.explanation_cz: one drží jednotné číslo — a bez `a`: in one day, ne `in a one day`.

items.explanation: Currencies count too: twenty euros, five pounds.
items.explanation_cz: Měny se také počítají: twenty euros, five pounds.

items.explanation: Units of measure take plural -s: ten kilometres, two hours.
items.explanation_cz: Jednotky mají množné -s: ten kilometres, two hours.

items.explanation: Some plurals are irregular: child → children, person → people.
items.explanation_cz: Některá množná čísla jsou nepravidelná: child → children, person → people.

items.explanation: five hours, not `five hour` — the plural -s stays even after big numbers.
items.explanation_cz: five hours, ne `five hour` — množné -s zůstává i po velkých číslech.

items.explanation: Number + plural: two tickets.
items.explanation_cz: Číslo + množné číslo: two tickets.

cards.title: Countable and uncountable
cards.body: countable nouns = you can countable them (1 apple, 2 apples). uncountable nouns = mass / idea (water, advice) — no plural number.
cards.body_cz: Počitatelná = 1, 2, 3… (jablko, jablka). Nepočitatelná = látka / pojem (voda, rada) — bez čísla v množném.
points: Not: two waters (for this pack) · Not: an advice

cards.title: Common uncountables
points: Use some / a lot of / much
cards.body: These English nouns are uncountable (no a/an, no plural -s in the usual sense).
cards.body_cz: V angličtině nepočitatelná — ne a/an, ne běžné množné -s.

cards.title: a / an / some / any
points: some/any with plural countable or uncountable

cards.title: False friends
points: Use some / a lot of / a piece of advice

cards.title: Practice focus
points: some/any with plural countable or uncountable

cards.title: Remember
points: uncountable: some · much · little · no a/an
cards.body_cz: počitatelné vs nepočitatelné — a/an jen u 1 ks
